data.summary: ddflow doctor reports no first-turn token cost: the SessionStart payload (5.6 KB), MCP instructions (12.4 KB) and tools/list (104 KB, 123 tools) are not measured or budgeted together, so a spawned agent's 64K start is invisible. Planned in P-lean-start (LS-measure). Repro: ddflow doctor | grep -i token (nothing)

data.claim: As-is first turn is 37.2K (haiku probe) without ddflow; ddflow adds 3.9K when tool search defers its 123 tools and ~59K when it does not; a restricted tools list drops 25.4K to 10.4K; core tier alone saves 27K undeferred.
data.falsifier: A probe on the operator's actual subagent model/window showing ddflow deferred yet total >60K, or restricted tools not lowering input tokens.
data.mechanism: Claude Code defers MCP schemas only when tool search triggers (auto threshold is a share of the window); otherwise every schema and the server instructions are sent in the first request.
data.probe: claude -p 'reply ok' --output-format json --model haiku, 13 variants (strict-mcp-config, DDFLOW_MCP_TOOLS=core, ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false|auto:90, disableAllHooks, --tools, --agents)
data.question: What does a freshly spawned Claude Code agent in this repo carry before work, and what gets it under 32K tokens?

data.body: Operator 2026-10-21 verbatim: 'I have noticed that every new agent you spawn (background tasks on claude) immediately starts with 64k tokens taken. Can you investigate how we can optimize the tokens in the beginning of the sessions, still informing the models to ask us for additional information and enforcing what we need, but looking into working with <32K tokens in the beginning of the session at least so we could support models with smaller context windows?' Research: docs/ddflow/research/lean-start.md (R-lean-start-footprint). Measured: as-is 37.2K without ddflow; ddflow adds 3.9K deferred or ~59K undeferred; restricted tools list 25.4K -> 10.4K. Enforcement stays in hooks and gates, the charter only tells the contract. Early tasks (LS-measure, LS-inherit-probe, then LS-charter, LS-agents, LS-worker-mcp-config, LS-launch-brief-budget) need nothing from P-tool-diet or MTD-decision; LS-profile-select and LS-lean-profile wait for MTD-profiles and MTD-search-call.
data.title: Lean start: a spawned agent starts under 32K tokens (lean profile 8-16K), contract kept, budget measured and ratcheted

data.body: Counts bytes and tokens (bytes/4, calibrated ratio in a knob, no tokenizer dependency) of: MCP initialize instructions, tools/list for the active [mcp].tools profile, hooks session-start output, brief --for-agent. Doctor prints the line and warns over budget; test_session_start_budget.py ratchets like tests/test_mcp_tool_budget.py. Also fixes B-doctor-no-session-start-cost (regression test: doctor output contains the line). Relates to DX-tools-list-budget-doctor-brief and DX-dead-knob-tools-budget: coordinate, do not duplicate.

data.body: Measured: restricted tools list 25.4K -> 10.4K first turn. Claude-only files first; syncing to other harnesses is B-sub-sync (related, not a prerequisite). Each definition body is a short charter pointer plus the role's contract. LS-measure's meter reports the per-role number.
